name: Forkline
summary: A split Export button whose halves part, folds down a format menu and flies your pick into place
about: A sales report card with a two-part export button: the main half runs the export and the arrow half opens a menu of five formats. Opening parts the halves along a glowing seam, flips the arrow and folds the menu items down like paper; picking one sends its file badge along an arc into the button while the label rolls. Exporting dips the button, fills it with a striped bar in three named stages, draws a tick, pops paper bits and drops the file into Recent exports.
how: Press the arrow half (or focus it and press Enter, Space or the Down arrow) to open the format menu.
Move with the arrow keys, Home or End, or type a format's first letter; Escape closes the menu.
Pick a format: its badge flies into the main half and the label changes to match.
Press the main half to export: watch the stages, the tick and the new chip in Recent exports.
